Center is entirely blank for separate plus/gear symbols. Exact circular symmetry and clean anti-aliased silhouette. Fit entire disk inside x/y 6% to 94% of square canvas, centered. No extra internal dark ring, detached center, black outlines, symbols or holes.

jobs.title: Retrato do Carteiro em 4K
jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. OUTPUT RESOLUTION: 3840 x 3840 pixels, full native 4K master.
Input image is the exact edit target and authoritative character identity. Re-render this same portrait at native 4K with clean smooth cartoon painting, removing low-resolution artifacts, visible stray colored pixels and tiny brush streaks. Preserve the EXACT character identity, head proportions, pose, expression, eye placement and gaze, smiling mouth, orange swept hair, purple postal cap with golden envelope emblem, green eyes, red coat, teal scarf and cream lapel. Preserve the same framing and red rounded-square background behind the character, and true transparency beyond that background. No external avatar frame in this image. Keep large clean glossy highlights and rich colored shadows, no realistic hair texture or grain. Do not change the character, costume, haircut, head direction, add accessories or zoom/crop differently. This is quality cleanup and high-resolution redraw of the existing portrait, not a new character design. No letters, watermark or text.
